name: 18503 · Scranton, PA
findings: ZIP 18503 (Scranton) has 95 nonprofit organizations. 40 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 18503 (Scranton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 18503 (Scranton) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 42.3 times the typical level).
